$comment: EDE-273 (#EDE-241 P6.1, 2026-11-27): SYSTEM SETTINGS, Mint's cinnamon-settings on eDE. ONE window of the shell (apps/ede/ui/settings.express, a `window` surface: a normal toplevel with eDE's frame and its own taskbar entry, app id at.exponential.settings, a single instance: asked again it comes to the front; closed from its frame, the next open starts on the grid). `title` = the window's title on the grid. `categories` = the grid's sections in order (Cinnamon's Appearance, Preferences, Hardware, then Exponential, then Administration). `modules` = THE catalogue, in each category's order (Cinnamon's: by name; Exponential's own order): {id (the module's route segment: `~/settings/<id>`), name (the tile's label AND the window's title while it is open, Cinnamon's wording), category, icon (a concept of packages/icons), keywords (cinnamon-settings' own `keywords` string where Mint has the module, a few eDE additions; none that only collides, e.g. no `screenshot` on Backgrounds), kind: module (a page in the window) | later (listed honestly, its page says it is not built yet) | launch (Mint's own tool: `command` runs, the window stays where it was) | page (#EDE-275: the Exponential category: the holder's own settings page opens as its own window over the session bus, `page` = a window key (`device:`, the bus's `page {key}`) or an in-app link (`~/settings/account`, the bus's `open {link}`), with the press's activation token; one implementation of those pages, as Cinnamon's tiles that are tools of their own), opens? (an alias: Account Details and Online Accounts open Exponential's Account), tabs? (#EDE-274: the module's stack switcher in the header, cinnamon-settings' pages of one module, [{value, label}] in order)}. `aliases` = the page ids links used before #EDE-273 (the applets, the panel menu, a person's documents) and the module they mean. SELECTORS: settingsGrid(query, installed) -> [{id, title, modules [{id, name, icon, kind, later (kind is later), installed (a launch or page module: its id is in `installed` = the launch modules whose command the host finds and the page modules while the holder can open them (signed in); every other kind true)}]}]: q = query trimmed and lowercased; empty = every module; else a module is listed when its name (lowercased) or its keywords (lowercased) CONTAIN q (Cinnamon's filter_visible_function), and a category with no listed module is left out. settingsNavigate(state, event, installed) -> {state, launch, title}: navigate's result also carries `page` (a holder page to open, else null). state = {module (`` = the grid), query (as typed), tab (the open module's page of its stack, `` without one)}; launch = a command to run or null; title = the open module's name, else `title`. EVENTS: open {id} (a tile's press): an unknown id changes nothing; an alias resolves to its target; a launch module whose tool is installed launches (state unchanged), else (not installed) its page opens; a page module the holder can open hands `page` over (state unchanged), else (signed out) its page in the window says Connect Exponential; any other module opens (module = its id, tab = its first page or ``, the query kept for back). back (the header's back button, Alt+Left): in a module the grid again (tab ``), query kept, and the keyboard back in the search; on the grid nothing. query {text}: on the grid the search text (it filters live); in a module ignored (the search is the grid's). submit (Enter in the search; Mint's cinnamon-settings binds none, eDE opens the best match): on the grid with a non-empty trimmed query, `open` of the BEST listed module: rank 0 = its name (lowercased) starts with q, 1 = its name contains q, 2 = only its keywords do; ties keep settingsGrid's order (the tiles stay in Cinnamon's order, only Enter ranks); no match, an empty query or a module open: nothing. link {target} (`~/settings/<module>` from the start menu's search, a link, an applet; `~/settings` alone or a bare id too; an old page id through `aliases`): the query cleared; an unknown target = the grid; a launch module with its tool launches and a page module the holder can open hands `page` over, the window showing the grid; else that module on its first page. tab {value} (#EDE-274, the stack switcher): a page the open module lists becomes `tab`; another value, or on the grid, nothing. Any other event changes nothing. The WINDOW: the header carries the back button and the module's name while a module is open (and its stack switcher, a Segmented, centred) and the search on the grid (focused whenever the grid shows); Enter in the search = submit; tiles are 104 px wide with a 48 px icon disc and the name under it (a later module's name muted); a module's page is a centred column (640 px) of framed groups (a title, then a bordered box of rows divided by hairlines). A setting the machine cannot apply yet is a read-only value row, never a dead control.

grid.name: no query: every category in Cinnamon's order plus Exponential before Administration, every module
a name matches as a substring, case-blind: 'sou' finds Sound, System Info (its keyword sound) and Software Sources
'hot' lists every name or keyword holding it, in Cinnamon's order
a keyword matches: 'wifi' finds Network and Driver Manager
the query is trimmed and lowercased
an Exponential module by keyword: 'claude' finds Agents
a launch module whose tool is missing is still listed, not installed

navigate.name: open a module from the grid: its page, the window titled by it
open keeps the query for back
an alias opens its target: Account Details is Exponential's Account
Online Accounts is Exponential's Account too
an unknown module changes nothing
a later module opens its honest page
a launch module with its tool installed launches it and stays on the grid
a launch module without its tool opens its page (not installed)
back from a module returns to the grid with the query kept
back on the grid changes nothing
typing in the search on the grid stores the text as typed
a query in a module is ignored
Enter opens the best match: a name starting with the query first ('sou': Sound)
Enter on 'hot' opens Hot Corners (a name starting with it), never a keyword hit
a name containing the query beats a keyword ('tiling': Window Tiling over Windows)
with no name holding the query, the first keyword hit in grid order ('wallpaper': Backgrounds)
ties keep the grid's order ('s': Screensaver before Sound)
Enter with no match changes nothing
Enter with an empty query changes nothing
Enter on a launch module launches it
Enter in a module changes nothing
a link ~/settings/<module> opens it with the query cleared
a bare module id is a link too
an old page id still lands: datetime is Date & Time
an old page id: defaults is Preferred Applications
a link to an alias lands on its target
a link to a launch module with its tool launches it, the window on the grid
~/settings alone is the grid
an unknown link is the grid
a module with a stack opens on its first page
the stack switcher picks a page of the open module
a page the module does not have changes nothing
the stack switcher on the grid changes nothing
back leaves the module's page too
a link to a module with a stack opens its first page
an Exponential page with the holder signed in opens the holder's own window (a settings link)
This Device opens the holder's device page by its window key
Account Details is Exponential's Account page too
signed out, an Exponential page opens in the window (Connect Exponential)
a link to an Exponential page opens the holder's window, the settings window on the grid
Enter on an Exponential page opens the holder's window
an unknown event changes nothing
